news.headline: Pressure mounts on India poll chief Gyanesh Kumar over voter list changes
news.body: Protests and political pressure intensified in New Delhi as opposition groups demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged widespread removals from voter rolls. The controversy follows reporting of internal objections to the verification process and could complicate preparations for upcoming elections.
